real_defects.issue: A preference-restoring snippet opened the page script with `if (typeof document === 'undefined' || typeof localStorage === 'undefined') return;`. With site data blocked, `typeof localStorage` throws SecurityError, so the page's whole script stopped at load. Reproduced in Chromium with a throwing getter. Fixed by putting the probe in try; check_storage_guard.unguarded_typeof guards it.

real_defects.file: 8 page modules (amazon-fba scenarios, clothing-design-studio bom/launchbrief, revenue-target-lead-planner history, shop-rates, shopify-a11y quote/theme-areas, shopify-permission-drift capture)
real_defects.issue: 18 exported functions defaulted `storage = globalThis.localStorage`, which is read outside any try when the page calls them with no argument, so 9 pages (7 clothing studio, revenue planner, shopify capture) stopped at load with site data blocked. Fixed with a guarded browserStorage() default; check_storage_guard.default_param_reads guards it.

real_defects.file: 8 venture pages (amazon-fba, change-order, chargeback, cut-list, locksmith, retainage, shop-rate, subcontractor)
real_defects.issue: A bare `localStorage` read or pass at start-up stopped the page with site data blocked; chargeback's getEvents also threw on bad JSON. Fixed (guarded getter or try); inline_reads holds inline scripts at zero; blocked_storage_pages.mjs: 0 of 3,820 pages throw after the fix (38 before).

Bare reads in click/change handlers (clear draft, reset, save draft, opt-out, backup, usage counts on download/copy) threw for visitors blocking site data, breaking that control. All wrapped or routed through a guarded getter; vendor-rate-break-even now says 'Not saved' instead of failing silently.

DOM clobbering: <button id="reset"> inside the form made form.reset that button, so the 'Reset saved inputs' / reset button threw 'form.reset is not a function' for every visitor. A Chromium scan of all 3,820 pages found 7 forms with reset shadowed; these 3 call it. cash-runway-planner's wire test passed because its fake form had a working reset(); the fake now models the shadowing. Fixed with HTMLFormElement.prototype.reset.call(form); guarded by the new platform/ci/check_form_clobbering.py (run by unwired_checks).
